segments.ja529:1.1: “Tassa sutvā sataṃ dammi, sahassaṃ diṭṭha [daṭṭhu (sī. pī.)] soṇakaṃ;
segments.ja529:2.3: Mayhaṃ sutvā sataṃ dehi, sahassaṃ diṭṭha [daṭṭhu (sī. pī.)] soṇakaṃ;
segments.ja529:2.5: Ahaṃ te soṇakakkhissaṃ [ahaṃ soṇakamakkhissaṃ (sī. pī.), ahaṃ te soṇakamakkhissaṃ (syā.)], sahāyaṃ paṃsukīḷitaṃ”.
segments.ja529:3.1: “Katamasmiṃ [katarasmiṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] so janapade, raṭṭhesu nigamesu ca;
segments.ja529:3.3: Kattha soṇakamaddakkhi [kattha te soṇako diṭṭho (sī. pī.)], taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito”.
segments.ja529:5.3: Tesaṃ mūlamhi [mūlasmiṃ (sī. pī.), mūlasmi (syā.)] soṇako, jhāyatī anupādano [anupādino (syā.), anupādāno (pī.)];
segments.ja529:6.3: Kārāpetvā samaṃ maggaṃ, agamā yena soṇako.
segments.ja529:9.3: ‘Na rāja kapaṇo hoti, dhammaṃ kāyena phassayaṃ [phusayaṃ (ka.)].
segments.ja529:10.3: Sa rāja kapaṇo hoti, pāpo pāpaparāyano’”.
segments.ja529:11.3: Kacci bhoto sukhasseyyā [sukhā seyyā (pī.), sukhaseyyo (ka.)], idha pattassa soṇaka’”.
segments.ja529:12.3: Na tesaṃ koṭṭhe openti, na kumbhiṃ na khaḷopiyaṃ [na kumbhe na kaḷopiyā (syā. pī.)];
segments.ja529:13.3: Anavajjapiṇḍo [anavajjo piṇḍā (pī.)] bhottabbo, na ca kocūparodhati.
segments.ja529:14.3: Nibbuto piṇḍo bhottabbo, na ca kocūparodhati.
segments.ja529:15.3: Muttassa raṭṭhe carato, saṅgo yassa na vijjati.
segments.ja529:17.3: Raṭṭhe vilumpamānamhi [viluppamānamhi (ka.)], nāssa kiñci ahīratha [ahāratha (sī. syā.)].
segments.ja529:18.3: Corehi rakkhitaṃ maggaṃ, ye caññe paripanthikā;
segments.ja529:19.3: Yaṃ yaṃ disaṃ pakkamati, anapekkhova gacchati”.
segments.ja529:20.1: “Bahūpi bhadrā [bahūni samaṇabhadrāni (sī.), bahūpi bhadrakā ete (pī.)] etesaṃ, yo tvaṃ bhikkhu pasaṃsasi;
segments.ja529:20.3: Ahañca giddho kāmesu, kathaṃ kāhāmi soṇaka.
segments.ja529:21.1: “Piyā me mānusā kāmā, atho dibyāpi me piyā;
segments.ja529:21.3: Atha kena nu vaṇṇena, ubho loke labhāmase”.
segments.ja529:22.1: “Kāme giddhā [kāmesu giddhā (sī. pī.)] kāmaratā, kāmesu adhimucchitā;
segments.ja529:23.1: “Ye ca kāme pahantvāna [pahatvāna (sī. pī.)], nikkhantā akutobhayā;
segments.ja529:24.3: Upamāya midhekacce [pidhekacce (sī. pī.)], atthaṃ jānanti paṇḍitā.
segments.ja529:26.3: Tattha rattiṃ tattha divā, tattheva nirato mano.
segments.ja529:27.1: “Khādaṃ nāgassa maṃsāni, pivaṃ bhāgīrathodakaṃ [bhāgirasodakaṃ (sī. syā. pī. ka.)];
segments.ja529:29.1: “So ca bhakkhaparikkhīṇo, udapatvā [uppatitvā (sī. syā.), udāpatvā (pī.)] vihaṅgamo.
segments.ja529:29.3: Na pacchato na purato, nuttaraṃ nopi dakkhiṇaṃ.
segments.ja529:30.1: “Dīpaṃ so najjhagāgañchi [na ajjhagañchi (sī.), na ajjhagacchi (pī.)], agatī yattha pakkhinaṃ;
segments.ja529:30.3: So ca tattheva pāpattha, yathā dubbalako tathā.
segments.ja529:31.3: Pasayhakārā khādiṃsu, phandamānaṃ vipakkhakaṃ [vipakkhinaṃ (sī. pī.), vipakkhikaṃ (syā.)].
segments.ja529:32.3: Giddhā ce na vamissanti, kākapaññāva [kākapaññāya (sī. syā. pī.)] te vidū.
segments.ja529:33.3: Tvañca paññāyase tena, yadi kāhasi vā na vā.
segments.ja529:34.3: Tatuttariṃ na bhāseyya, dāsovayyassa [dāso ayyassa (sī.), dāso ayirassa (pī.)] santike”.
segments.ja529:36.1: “Ko nume rājakattāro, suddā veyyattamāgatā [sūtā veyyattimāgatā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja529:38.3: Taṃ rajje abhisiñcassu, so no rājā bhavissati”.
segments.ja529:39.3: Taṃ rajje abhisiñcissaṃ, so vo rājā bhavissati”.
segments.ja529:40.3: Taṃ disvā ālapī rājā, ekaputtaṃ manoramaṃ.
segments.ja529:41.3: Te putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te.
segments.ja529:44.3: Te putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te.
segments.ja529:47.3: Te putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te.
segments.ja529:50.3: Te putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te.
segments.ja529:52.3: Tā putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te.
segments.ja529:54.5: Tā putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te.
segments.ja529:56.1: “Daharasseva me tāta, mātā matāti me sutaṃ;
segments.ja529:56.3: Tayā vinā ahaṃ tāta, jīvitumpi na ussahe.
segments.ja529:58.3: Subharo te bhavissāmi, na te hessāmi dubbharo”.
segments.ja529:59.3: Vohāro tattha gaṇheyya, vāṇijā byasanī [byasanaṃ (ka.)] siyā.
segments.ja529:61.3: Tā naṃ tattha ramessanti [ramissanti (syā. ka.)], tāhi ceso [meso (pī.)] ramissati.
segments.ja529:62.3: Taṃ disvā avacuṃ kaññā, dīghāvuṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhanaṃ.
segments.ja529:63.1: “Devatā nusi gandhabbo, adu [ādu (sī. pī.)] sakko purindado;
segments.ja529:63.3: Ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ”.
segments.ja529:64.1: “Namhi devo na gandhabbo, nāpi [namhi (ka.)] sakko purindado;
segments.ja529:64.5: Mamaṃ [mama (pī.)] bharatha bhaddaṃ vo [bhaddante (ka.)], ahaṃ bhattā bhavāmi vo”.
segments.ja529:65.3: ‘Kuhiṃ rājā anuppatto, ito rājā kuhiṃ gato’”.
